title: TimeScheduler
description: Schedules automatic world time changes with configurable difficulty, PvP, sounds, and announcement messages.
body:
# Time Scheduler

**Time Scheduler** is a plugin designed to schedule automatic actions based on the time of day in your server worlds.

With it, you can configure specific events such as **sunrise** and **sunset** to trigger predefined actions automatically. For example, the plugin can play a custom sound when the day starts, play another sound when night begins, enable or disable PvP, and send personalized messages to online players.

The plugin also supports **multiple worlds individually**, allowing each world to have its own configuration, messages, sounds, and event behavior. This makes it useful for servers with different game modes, survival worlds, RPG areas, event maps, or custom world-based rules.

## Features

* Schedule automatic actions for sunrise and sunset
* Play predefined sounds when specific day/night events happen
* Enable or disable PvP automatically
* Send custom messages to players
* Configure each world individually
* Customize messages and sounds per world
* Customize behavior for each event
* Useful for survival, RPG, event, and multi-world servers

## Multi-world support

Each world can have its own independent settings.
You can define different sounds, messages, and PvP behavior depending on the world and the event being triggered.

For example:

* A survival world can disable PvP during the day and enable it at night
* An RPG world can play immersive sounds at sunrise and sunset
* An event world can send special messages when night begins
* Each world can have its own unique atmosphere and rules

## Why use Time Scheduler?

**Time Scheduler** helps server owners automate world-based routines and create a more dynamic experience for players. Instead of manually changing PvP settings, sending messages, or triggering sounds, the plugin handles these actions automatically according to the time cycle of each configured world.
